role.label: Sales channels
role.help: Users with this role only see and change the orders and customers of these sales channels. Leave empty for no limit. A user with several roles gets the channels of all of them; one role without channels removes the limit.

preset.label: Permission presets
preset.applied: Preset "{name}" added to the permissions. Save the role to keep it.

help.orders: Adds everything the order module needs, including documents (create, upload, download, send, delete), refunds, discounts and payment states. Existing permissions stay. Note: deleting documents needs the Documents settings permission "delete", which also allows deleting document settings.
help.products: Adds everything the product module needs, including media, Shopping Experience layouts, reviews and the Commercial extensions on the product page (bundles, review summaries). It also adds the Reviews module (Catalogue → Reviews): view, approve, edit and delete the reviews of the role's sales channels. Existing permissions stay.
help.categories: Adds everything the category module needs, including layouts, SEO settings and product assignments. Existing permissions stay.
help.settings: Adds the role's own sales channels (Sales Channels in the main menu) and the settings pages with a sales channel switch (basic information, cart, login & registration, newsletter, sitemap, SEO URL templates), for the role's own sales channels only. Settings for all channels, the other settings pages, and creating or deleting sales channels stay with unrestricted users. Existing permissions stay.
help.cms: Adds everything the Shopping Experiences module needs (view, edit, create, delete layouts, with media). Limited users edit the layouts of their own sales channels; shared and locked layouts are read-only. Existing permissions stay.

product.readOnlyText: This product is also sold in sales channels outside your role. Its data applies to all of them, so only users responsible for every one of these channels can change it.
product.readOnlyTooltip: Read-only: the product is also sold in other sales channels

category.readOnlyText: This category is also used by sales channels outside your role, or it is above the start of your channels' category tree. Changes would affect those channels too, so only users responsible for all of them can change it. You can add and change subcategories that belong only to your channels.
category.readOnlyTooltip: Read-only: the category is also used by other sales channels

cms.readOnlyText: This layout is also used by sales channels outside your role (by their categories, products, landing pages or as a default layout). Changes would affect those channels too, so only users responsible for all of them can change it. You can duplicate it and use the copy in your channels.
